question: When 7516, 7635 and 7992 are divided by the greatest number x, then the remainder in each case is the same. The product of the digits of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The greatest number leaving the same remainder is the HCF of their absolute differences.

Differences = (7635 − 7516), (7992 − 7635), (7992 − 7516) = 119, 357, 476.

x = HCF(119, 357, 476) = 119.

Product of digits of x = 1 × 1 × 9 = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 7516, 7635, and 7992.

**Formula Used:**

The greatest number x that divides given numbers a, b, and c leaving the same remainder is given by x = HCF(|a − b|, |b − c|, |c − a|).

**Calculations:**

⇒ |a − b| = 7635 − 7516 = 119

⇒ |b − c| = 7992 − 7635 = 357

⇒ |c − a| = 7992 − 7516 = 476

⇒ x = HCF(119, 357, 476)

⇒ We can observe that 357 = 119 × 3 and 476 = 119 × 4.

⇒ Hence, the HCF of 119, 357, and 476 is 119, meaning x = 119.

⇒ We need the product of the digits of x.

⇒ Product of digits = 1 × 1 × 9 = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF of Numbers with Different Remainders

When finding the greatest number dividing a, b, c and leaving remainders r₁, r₂, r₃ respectively, the required number is HCF(a − r₁, b − r₂, c − r₃).

LCM of Numbers Leaving the Same Remainder

To find the smallest number which when divided by x, y, and z leaves the same remainder r in each case, the number is LCM(x, y, z) + r.

Difference Property of HCF

The HCF of any set of numbers is always a factor of their absolute differences. This property simplifies finding the HCF of large numbers by focusing on evaluating the smallest difference between them.
